segments.text: What if AI could design your UI for you in real time? Open Pencil is an open-source AI native alternative to Figma. Instead of dragging boxes for
hours, it runs an MCP server in the background. So, you can open clawed code and literally type generate a rover management dashboard using the editorial
style guide and watch the AI place and style components on your canvas live.
ships with a gallery of professional style guides.
